questions.prompt: How many eggs do 4 chickens lay in 9 days?
questions.guidance: First derive eggs per chicken per day from the base case (1.5 chickens, 1.5 eggs, 1.5 days = 1 egg/chicken/day), then multiply by 4 chickens and 9 days.

math.setup: Base rate: 1.5 eggs / (1.5 chickens × 1.5 days) = 1 egg per chicken per day. New scenario: 4 chickens × 9 days × 1 egg/chicken/day. Alternatively: 9 days / 1.5 days = 6 times the base period; 4 chickens would lay 4 eggs in 1.5 days (base period scaled); 4 × 6 = 24.
steps: 4 chickens × 1 egg/chicken per base period = 4 eggs in base period
